title: Rav Achai (bar Ada, according to the Maharshal’s reading) of Acha
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Kiddushin 22b](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.22b.18) concerning a halakhah; Hyman sees some indication there that he lived in Rav Ashi’s time.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Hebrew gives Rav Achai of Acha, with bar Ada in brackets. Hyman attributes bar Ada to Maharshal and sees some indication that Achai lived in Rav Ashi’s time.
